name: The Deck of Many Things
clause: 20 | Put a creature card from any graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. When that creature dies, its owner loses the game.

needs.semantics: The existing `this-turn:dies` / `this-turn:ltb` expire at this turn's cleanup (CR 603.7b). A 'When that creature dies, ...' created with no printed duration must watch the bound object for the rest of the game.
needs.clause: When that creature dies, its owner loses the game.

needs.semantics: The named player(s) lose the game immediately - a real loss, not a life change, so 'owner-of-that' can be named. Today the only approximation is `set-life 0`, whose `who` is limited to you / each-player.
needs.clause: When that creature dies, its owner loses the game.
